# LJ Web Management

> LJ Web Management builds custom, done-for-you AI automation systems that remove repetitive tasks and bottlenecks, connecting the business tools a team already uses so people can save time and focus on growth.

LJ Web Management is based in Lockport, Illinois, and works with businesses across 44+ industries. Rather than selling off-the-shelf software, the company scopes and builds automations tailored to a client's specific role, tools, and workflow, then delivers a flat, upfront quote before any work begins. The catalog covers 400+ pre-scoped, done-for-you automations organized by industry and job role (real estate, healthcare, legal, home services, restaurants, e-commerce, and dozens more), alongside larger platform-scale solutions for businesses that need more than a single automation.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://ljwebmanagement.com/): Overview of what LJ Web Management does and how automation engagements start.
- [How It Works](https://ljwebmanagement.com/how-it-works): Explains the process from consultation to flat quote to delivery.
- [Automations](https://ljwebmanagement.com/automations): Browsable catalog of 400+ done-for-you automations across 44+ industries, searchable by industry.
- [Solutions](https://ljwebmanagement.com/solutions): Platform-scale offerings, including Custom Website Design & Development (with SEO and POS integration), Obsolescence Management, ERP Implementation & Integration, Managed SaaS Delivery & Support, LMS Deployment, and Restaurant POS Systems.
- [Book a Consultation](https://ljwebmanagement.com/appointment): Schedule a free consultation to scope an automation project.
- [Contact Us](https://ljwebmanagement.com/contactus): General contact information and inquiry form.
- [Blog](https://blog.ljwebmanagement.com): Articles on business automation and related topics.
